# Contributing to the SMAIL website

Thank you for helping. Fixes to the site are welcome.

## Good first changes
- Fix a typo or a broken link.
- Improve the Arabic text.
- Fix how a page looks on a phone.
- Make a page easier to use or read.

## How to change something
1. Fork the repo and make a branch.
2. Run the site on your computer (see the README).
3. Open the pages you touched in both English and Arabic, on a wide screen and a phone.
4. Open a pull request and say what you changed and why.

## People, photos and news
Please don't edit `data/*.json` or the member photos in a pull request unless you are on the SMAIL team. Those updates go through the team's Slack bot so they can be previewed and approved. If you spot a mistake, open an issue instead.

## Rules
- Never add a person's photo or details without their permission.
- Don't add secrets, tokens or private emails.
- Keep every text change in both English and Arabic.
- Be kind. See the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
